name: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
